name: Halloween Hero!
source:
She smirked at the mess she made, seemingly pleased with what she's done. I brace myself for the impact of the spell but...nothing. When I returned my gaze to where she was standing, she was gone.  I hear cries of agony swirl up and swallow me. 

'How am I going to fix this?'

Overworked and stressed out of your mind, you decide to take a break and go to a Halloween party with your friend. But when a wicked witch casts a spell, turning everybody into their costumes, you try your best to save them. It's your responsibility now. Right?

[From [url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/halloween-hero]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
她看着自己弄得一团乱，得意地笑了，似乎对自己所做的很满意。我做好了应对咒语影响的准备，但……什么也没有。当我把目光转回她站的地方时，她已经不见了。我听到痛苦的呼喊声盘旋而上，吞噬了我。

“我该如何解决这个问题？”

由于过度劳累和精神压力，你决定休息一下并与朋友一起去参加万圣节派对。但是，当邪恶的女巫施展咒语，将每个人都变成她们的服装时，你会尽力拯救他们。现在是你的责任了。正确的？
